pages.title: Lilo Feeding Pudge the Fish a Peanut Butter Sandwich Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo offers Pudge a peanut butter sandwich in this printable coloring page, bending toward the fish as it surfaces beside the rocks. Her leaf-print dress, sandals, and the starfish by the tide pool add separate shapes to color.

pages.title: Lilo and Nani Looking at Their Family Photo Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Lilo and Nani look at a family photo together, with Nani kneeling and resting a hand on Lilo's shoulder. The wavy photo border frames two smiling faces, and a hibiscus sits in a vase behind them.

pages.title: Lilo Swimming past a Hammerhead Shark Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lilo swimming past a hammerhead shark, with her hair flowing behind her and bubbles rising between them. The shark's broad head and fins make large coloring areas above Lilo's patterned outfit and the sea plants below.

pages.title: Lilo Building a Sandcastle with a Bucket and Shovel Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo builds a sandcastle in this printable coloring page, holding a shovel over its top tower and gripping a bucket with her other hand. A shell and a starfish sit in the sand, with gentle wave lines behind the castle.

pages.title: Lilo Stringing a Flower Lei Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Lilo sits cross-legged and threads a flower onto a lei draped across her lap. The leaf print on her dress leaves broad areas to color, while loose blossoms beside her have smaller details at their centers.

pages.title: Lilo Sewing a Button Eye on Scrump Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo sews a button eye onto Scrump in this printable coloring page, holding the rag doll upright as she guides the needle through the button. A loop of thread, Scrump's stitched mouth, and the bow on its head surround the sewing scene.

pages.title: Lilo Serving Tea to Scrump Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lilo serving tea to Scrump, tipping a flower-patterned teapot toward a cup on a low table. Scrump sits upright in a chair, with its large bow and button eye clearly outlined.

pages.title: Lilo Showing Scrump to Mertle and the Hula Girls Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo holds out Scrump for Mertle and the hula girls in this printable coloring page, with Mertle reacting from behind round glasses. Three dancers watch in flower crowns and leaf skirts, while the doll's bow and stitched mouth sit between the two girls.

pages.title: Lilo Practicing Hula with Moses Puloki Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Lilo practices hula with Moses Puloki, holding one hand across her body as he demonstrates the same gesture. Their leaf skirts and wrist decorations add small shapes around the open areas of the figures.

pages.title: Lilo Looking at a Picture of Her Mother in Hula Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo studies a portrait of her mother in this printable coloring page, seated on a bench and holding the frame in both hands. Her mother wears a flower lei and raises one arm in a hula pose, and a hibiscus rests on the bench.

pages.title: Lilo Putting an Elvis Record on the Turntable Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Lilo placing an Elvis record on a turntable, holding the edges of the vinyl above the spindle. Rings mark the record's grooves, and the open player shows a tonearm, suitcase handle, and latches.

pages.title: Lilo Carrying Scrump to the Pelekai House Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo carries Scrump toward the Pelekai house in this printable coloring page, walking in sandals with the rag doll tucked against her chest. A curved path leads to the porch steps beneath a palm tree.

pages.title: Lilo Showing Cobra Bubbles the Adoption Papers Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Lilo holds up the adoption papers while Cobra Bubbles looks down with one hand at his chin. Her leaf-print dress and sandals contrast with his suit, tie, and narrow glasses.

pages.title: Lilo Trapped in a Capsule on Gantu's Spaceship Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo presses both palms against a capsule in this printable coloring page set aboard Gantu's spaceship. Gantu looms beside the glass, with curved armor, a broad boot, and rounded ship controls framing Lilo's leaf-print dress.

pages.title: Lilo Meeting the Grand Councilwoman on the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Lilo meets the Grand Councilwoman on the beach in this printable coloring page, looking up as the kneeling visitor rests a hand on her shoulder. The Councilwoman's sweeping robe fills one side, with a palm tree and calm water behind them.
